headline: Alpha Sugartini
title: Alpha Sugartini | Fire and Earth Boss Tips | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Alpha Sugartini is an Ice boss in Rosy Mirelands, levels sixty to sixty two. Ice takes extra damage from Fire and Earth, so bring those elements. Lightning, Water and Ice attacks hit it weakly. Defeating it unlocks the Sugartini evolution for your Sugarfish. Your Sugarfish also needs level sixty two and a Freeze Stone for that evolution. Which team are you bringing to this princess? Comment below!

scenes.sub: Ice boss, levels sixty to sixty two

description: Aniimo Alpha Sugartini boss tips: an Ice Alpha in Rosy Mirelands, levels 60 to 62, weak to Fire and Earth. Defeating it unlocks the Sugartini evolution for Sugarfish, which also needs level 62 and a Freeze Stone. Checked on aniimo.gg and GameWith in November 2026.
joke: Alpha Sugartini guards its reflection, so bring a very patient team.
